# Offline tom references

Author: **Glen MacArthur**. [Original AVL Drumkits](https://www.bandshed.net/avldrumkits/).
Retrieved from a pinned [StudioRack mirror](https://github.com/studiorack/avl-drumkits).
CC BY-SA 3.0; included license applies to all fifteen FLAC files. See `sources.json`
for original URLs, revision, SHA-256 hashes and per-file inspection.

Low = Ludwig 18-inch floor tom; middle = Ludwig 16-inch floor tom;
high = Ludwig 14-inch tom. These are three drums, not three tunings of one drum.
Layers 1 through 5 are kept separately. They are not calibrated MIDI velocities.

These recordings are PC-only analysis assets and are never FPGA ROM contents.
Freesound quartertone's preferred same-drum pack required a logged-in original
download. The fallback was explicitly included in the approved implementation plan.

Numerical checks do not certify the absence of audible room sound or background
noise. No pre-strike noise interval is available; an SNR is deliberately not invented.
